lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That he, he was sorry for me ta see that stuff.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Did he ask you to shoot her too or did he tell you ta shoot her?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: When you got home from school, do you remember if a fire was going then?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (shakes head “no”) uh uh, I didn't look.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: When you knocked on the door to go in, was the fire going then?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK. When you knocked on the door to go into Steven's trailer, was it still light out?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK. You mentioned then you took her, her back out, you shot her, did anything else happen in this garage that, that is noteworthy cuz remember, remember we've, we've seen the garage we've got the evidence from the garage, um, did you guys do anything else with her out in the garage?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Anything with those ropes or bindings or anything like that?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You took her out ta the fire and you're sure you used this creeper thing, right?
